summary: Completed testing of Inquiry 3-Stage Flow (Terima → Kerjakan) and unified 'Tugas Saya' page for Engineering staff. All core features working correctly.
passed_tests: POST /api/inquiries/{id}/receive-job - Sets accepted_at timestamp correctly
POST /api/inquiries/{id}/start-job - Sets work_started_at timestamp correctly
GET /api/drawing-requests/my-queue - Returns inquiry_antri, inquiry_diterima, inquiry_proses buckets
Stage transition: assigned → inquiry_antri (no accepted_at)
Stage transition: after receive-job → inquiry_diterima (accepted_at set, no work_started_at)
Stage transition: after start-job → inquiry_proses (both timestamps set)
GET /api/engineering/workload/detail - Shows correct status labels for inquiries
Status label 'Dikerjakan' when work_started_at is set
Status label 'Diterima (antri)' when accepted_at set but not started
Status label 'Belum Diterima' when accepted_at is null
Frontend: /engineering/my-queue page loads without errors
Frontend: Unified 'Tugas Saya' panel displays (data-testid='myqueue-panel')
Frontend: Inquiry Costing section present with items
Frontend: Stage count badges display correctly (Antri, Diterima, Proses)
Frontend: 'TERIMA' button visible for inquiries in antri stage
Frontend: 'KERJAKAN' button visible for inquiries in diterima stage
Frontend: 'BUKA INQUIRY' button visible for inquiries in proses stage
Frontend: Drawing Request/SO section structure present
Inquiry items display with correct metadata (inquiry_no, title, customer, timestamps)
Authorization: Only assigned engineer (or admin/eng_head) can call receive-job
Authorization: Only assigned engineer (or admin/eng_head) can call start-job
Idempotent behavior: receive-job can be called multiple times safely
Idempotent behavior: start-job can be called multiple times safely
Cleanup: Test inquiries deleted successfully
